items.signal: A commonly monitored tomato disease example in cool, wet production periods.
items.action: Improve airflow, avoid wet foliage, and inspect lower leaves frequently.

items.signal: A commonly monitored tomato leaf-spot disease example in warm production conditions.
items.action: Remove spotted leaves, mulch soil, and water at the base.

items.signal: A commonly monitored leaf-spot disease example when leaf wetness and dense canopies occur.
items.action: Keep foliage dry, space plants well, and sanitize tools.

items.signal: A commonly monitored protected-crop disease example when humidity remains high.
items.action: Ventilate covered crops and remove affected leaves early.

items.signal: A commonly monitored bacterial-disease example where warm weather and splashing water occur.
items.action: Use clean transplants, avoid overhead watering, and disinfect tools.
